map.租赁（合同/条款）生成 使用指南: Lease Contract and Clause Generator Guide
map.按房屋、期限与双方信息生成合同底稿：核心条款固定输出，可选条款自选，未填项黄色标: Generate a lease draft from property, term and party details: core clauses always appear, optional clauses are selectable, missing fields are highlighted, and it is a drafting reference only.
map.按房屋、期限与双方信息生成租赁合同底稿；核心条款固定呈现、可选条款自选、未填项醒: Generate a lease draft from property, term and party details; core clauses always appear, optional clauses are selectable, missing fields are highlighted, and it is a drafting reference only, not legal advice.
map.填写甲方、乙方、房屋地址、建筑面积。: Enter party A, party B, property address and floor area.
map.填写租期开始/结束、月租金、押金月数、支付方式与费用承担方。: Enter lease start/end, monthly rent, deposit months, payment method and who bears utilities.
map.勾选需要的可选条款：费用承担、转租限制、房屋交接、提前解约。: Tick the optional clauses you need: cost allocation, sublet restriction, handover, early termination.
map.点「生成合同底稿」，逐项补齐黄色「【待填写：…】」后复制或下载 TXT，再交专业: Click Generate draft, fill every yellow “To be completed: …” item, then copy or download TXT and have a professional review it.
map.起草前先形成完整条款清单，避免漏掉租金、期限或押金。: Form a complete clause list before drafting so rent, term or deposit are not missed.
map.多套房源出草稿时统一口径，再逐份填实际数字。: Keep a consistent structure across multiple property drafts, then fill in actual figures.
map.把底稿交给当地专业人士按示范文本复核。: Have a local professional review the draft against a model contract.
map.缺失甲方与租金的底稿: Draft with party A and rent missing
map.只填地址、面积 89.5 ㎡、租期 2026-12-01 至 2027-11-3: Fill only the address, 89.5 m², term 2026-12-01 to 2027-11-30 and a two-month deposit, leaving rent blank: all core clauses still appear; party A shows “To be completed: party A name/ID”, rent shows “To be completed: monthly rent”, and the deposit amount is also flagged. Rent or term are never randomly omitted.
map.核心条款固定，只有四项可选条款由勾选决定；模板不保证适用于所有地区或商铺、群租、: Core clauses are fixed; only the four optional clauses depend on ticks. The template does not guarantee suitability for every region or for shops, shared rentals, mortgaged property or other special cases; check local law and model contracts before signing.
map.还会随机漏条款吗？: Can clauses still be randomly omitted?
map.不会，核心条款固定输出，可选条款由勾选决定。: No; core clauses always appear and optional clauses depend on your ticks.
